title: 柱色谱的操作与安全
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/10_Performing Column Chromatography.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/10_Performing Column Chromatography/src.py

points.K10: 先用薄层色谱选洗脱剂
points.K13: 干法易生气泡，轻敲排气
points.K18: 加保护砂层，加满洗脱剂

shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁架台和一根玻璃色谱柱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a ring stand holding a tall glass chromatography column and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学柱色谱的操作。

shots.scene: 棉花、砂、硅胶、试管架四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cotton ball, a pile of sand, a beaker of white slurry, and a rack of test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 装好柱、上好样、收好馏分。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一大瓶反应产物发愁，旁边一块小薄层板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks worried at a large flask of reaction product next to a tiny white plate.
shots.narration: 阿杰的产物有好几克，薄层板分不了。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着薄层板上的小斑点，又看看大烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares a tiny spot on a white plate with the large flask of product, frowning.
shots.narration: 一个小斑点，怎么拿到好几克纯品？

shots.scene: 小研扛来一根长长的玻璃色谱柱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries over a tall glass chromatography column and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：样品多，就上柱子。

shots.scene: 小研把柱子夹到实验台的铁架台上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clamps the column to a ring stand on an open lab bench while the young male student watches.
shots.narration: 我们从装柱开始，一步步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一块分出彩色斑点的板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a white plate with colored spots separated at different heights.
shots.narration: 复习一下：色谱按极性分离。

shots.scene: 流动相箭头推动斑点，固定相层拉住斑点
shots.prompt_en: Arrows of moving liquid push spots forward while a fixed layer holds some spots back. No people.
shots.narration: 各组分被固定相拉住的程度不同。

shots.scene: 一个小斑点和一大瓶样品对比
shots.prompt_en: A tiny spot on a plate compared with a large flask of liquid, with a size arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 薄层板只能分离一点点样品。

shots.scene: 化学、生物、工厂三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a chemistry flask, a DNA helix and a factory building, each with a small column icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样品多，就用柱色谱，用途很广。

shots.scene: 小研在空白屏幕前讲原理
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains in front of a blank screen to the young male student.
shots.narration: 原理先学懂，这里重点讲操作。

shots.scene: 空玻璃柱夹在铁架台上，底部有活塞
shots.prompt_en: An empty glass column clamped on a ring stand, with a stopcock at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 这是色谱柱，里面装固定相。

shots.scene: 液体带着样品从上往下流
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway column: liquid flows downward carrying colored bands through a packed white bed. No people.
shots.narration: 流动相带着样品，从上往下流。

shots.scene: 柱子下方排着编号的小锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: Below the column, a row of small conical flasks with number icons one to six. No people.
shots.narration: 下面用编号小瓶，一份份接馏分。

shots.scene: 不同颜色落在不同编号的瓶里
shots.prompt_en: Different colored liquids end up in different numbered flasks. No people.
shots.narration: 各组分走得快慢不同，分进不同瓶里。

shots.scene: 烧杯里白色硅胶与溶剂搅成匀浆
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of white silica powder being stirred with solvent into a smooth slurry. No people.
shots.narration: 最常用的是硅胶柱。

shots.scene: 柱中硅胶床标固定相，流过的液体标流动相
shots.prompt_en: A packed column: the white bed is highlighted, and the liquid passing through glows blue. No people.
shots.narration: 硅胶匀浆是固定相，溶剂是流动相。

shots.scene: 左边柱子，右边薄层板，色带对应
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: a column with colored bands and a plate with matching colored spots. No people.
shots.narration: 原理和薄层色谱一样。

shots.scene: 立体颗粒堆中小球穿行
shots.prompt_en: A 3D pile of tiny beads with small balls winding through the gaps. No people.
shots.narration: 只是从平面，变成了立体的填料。

shots.scene: 硅胶小珠表面伸出小钩，抓住极性分子
shots.prompt_en: A bead with many small hooks on its surface grabbing a polar molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 硅胶表面的羟基会吸附极性分子。

shots.scene: 慢球和快球对比
shots.prompt_en: A slow ball held by hooks and a fast ball sliding freely down a track. No people.
shots.narration: 极性大的走得慢，极性小的走得快。

shots.scene: 小研检查柱底活塞，转到关闭
shots.prompt_en: At an open lab bench, the female graduate student in goggles and gloves turns the stopcock at the bottom of a column to closed.
shots.narration: 开始装柱，先确认活塞关闭。

shots.scene: 棉花团被放进柱底
shots.prompt_en: A small cotton ball drops into the bottom of a glass column. No people.
shots.narration: 柱底塞一小团棉花。

shots.scene: 细粉从无棉花的柱底漏出，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fine powder leaking out of a column bottom without cotton, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 否则细硅胶粉会从底部漏出去。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒把棉花推到底
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod gently pushes the cotton down to the bottom of the column. No people.
shots.narration: 用玻璃棒轻轻推到底。

shots.scene: 柱子用夹子固定在铁架台上，竖直
shots.prompt_en: A column held vertically by a clamp on a ring stand with a heavy base, a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 用铁架台和夹子把柱子竖直夹牢。

shots.scene: 一薄层砂落在棉花上
shots.prompt_en: A thin layer of sand pours onto the cotton at the bottom of the column. No people.
shots.narration: 在棉花上铺一薄层砂。

shots.scene: 滴管加少量溶剂冲下壁上的砂
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds a little solvent around the inner wall to wash sand grains down. No people.
shots.narration: 用滴管加点溶剂，把壁上的砂冲下去。

shots.scene: 斜砂面和平砂面对比，轻敲柱壁
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a slanted sand layer and a level sand layer with a green check; a finger taps the column side. No people.
shots.narration: 砂面要水平，歪了就轻敲柱壁。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台上向硅胶中加溶剂
shots.prompt_en: At an open lab bench, the female graduate student in goggles and gloves adds solvent to a beaker of silica powder.
shots.narration: 向硅胶里加25毫升溶剂，调匀浆。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶图标，箭头流向柱子
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle icon with an arrow flowing into a column. No people.
shots.narration: 柱色谱用的溶剂，又叫洗脱剂。

shots.section_title: 先用薄层色谱选洗脱剂
shots.scene: 三块薄层板，各用不同溶剂展开
shots.prompt_en: Three small plates run in different solvents side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 洗脱剂可以先用薄层色谱来试。
overlay: 先用薄层色谱选洗脱剂

shots.section_title: 先用薄层色谱选洗脱剂
shots.scene: 分离最好的那块打勾，箭头指向柱子
shots.prompt_en: The plate with the best separated spots gets a green check, and an arrow points from it to a column. No people.
shots.narration: 挑分得最好的一种用到柱子上。

shots.section_title: 先用薄层色谱选洗脱剂
shots.scene: 板与柱的分离顺序一致
shots.prompt_en: A plate and a column side by side, matching spots and bands linked by dashed lines. No people.
shots.narration: 两者都用硅胶，分离规律一样。

shots.scene: 两个溶剂瓶等量混合
shots.prompt_en: Two solvent bottles with blank labels pouring equal amounts into one beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 这次示范用丙酮和乙醇等量混合。

shots.scene: 柱子三分之二处画线
shots.prompt_en: A column with a marked line at about two thirds of its height. No people.
shots.narration: 用量看柱子和样品，约装三分之二。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒搅拌出均匀匀浆
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod stirs the beaker until the white slurry looks smooth and even. No people.
shots.narration: 用玻璃棒搅成均匀的匀浆。

shots.scene: 小研举起烧杯过头，边搅边经漏斗把匀浆倒入柱中
shots.prompt_en: At an open lab bench, the female graduate student lifts the beaker above her head, stirs and quickly pours the slurry through a glass funnel into the top of the tall column.
shots.narration: 边搅边经漏斗，快速倒进柱子。

shots.scene: 洗瓶冲洗烧杯和柱壁
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle rinses leftover slurry from the beaker and down the column wall. No people.
shots.narration: 用溶剂冲净烧杯和柱壁上的残胶。

shots.scene: 湿法装柱图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of slurry pouring into a column with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这种方法叫湿法装柱。

shots.section_title: 干法易生气泡，轻敲排气
shots.scene: 干粉先装、后加溶剂，柱中出现气泡，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of dry powder in a column with many bubbles after solvent is added, marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 干法装柱容易出气泡，效果差。
overlay: 干法易生气泡，轻敲排气

shots.section_title: 干法易生气泡，轻敲排气
shots.scene: 手指轻敲柱壁，气泡上浮消失
shots.prompt_en: A finger gently taps the column wall and small bubbles rise and vanish; the top surface becomes flat. No people.
shots.narration: 装柱时轻敲柱壁，赶走气泡，顶面平整。

shots.scene: 打开活塞，溶剂滴入锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock opens and solvent drips into a conical flask below. No people.
shots.narration: 装好后，开活塞放掉一部分溶剂。

shots.scene: 液面始终高于硅胶面，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A column with the liquid level just above the white bed, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 液面必须始终高于硅胶。

shots.scene: 液面降到硅胶下，硅胶开裂，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a column where liquid dropped below the bed and the white bed has cracks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦跑干，硅胶开裂，分离就不准。

shots.scene: 液面停在硅胶面上方一点
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock closes as the liquid sits just a little above the bed. No people.
shots.narration: 上样前，液面降到略高于硅胶即可。

shots.scene: 两个小瓶，一红一蓝绿
shots.prompt_en: Two small vials, one red and one blue-green, with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 这次分离两种滴定用的指示剂。

shots.scene: 两个分子图标，一个带更多极性小标
shots.prompt_en: Two simple molecule icons; one has more small polarity markers attached. No people.
shots.narration: 结构不同，溴甲酚绿极性更大。

shots.scene: 彩色色带与无色柱子对比
shots.prompt_en: A column with bright colored bands next to a column with no visible bands and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有颜色好观察，实际样品多半看不见。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶里少量油状物，加少许溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask with a small amount of oily residue receiving a few drops of solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 样品用尽量少的溶剂溶解。

shots.scene: 窄色带打勾，宽色带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: one with a thin sharp band and a green check, one with a wide blurry band and a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上成窄带才分得开，太稀就铺散了。

shots.scene: 小研用滴管吸取绿色样品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves draws up a green sample with a glass dropper.
shots.narration: 上样要小心，用滴管吸约0.25毫升。

shots.scene: 滴管口贴近柱内硅胶面，沿壁慢慢放出
shots.prompt_en: A dropper tip held close to the bed inside the column releases liquid slowly down the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 管口贴近硅胶面，沿壁慢慢放出。

shots.scene: 硅胶面被冲出坑，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid splashing onto the bed and making a crater, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 动作要轻，别冲乱硅胶面。

shots.section_title: 加保护砂层，加满洗脱剂
shots.scene: 样品全部渗入硅胶，再撒一层砂
shots.prompt_en: The sample band soaks into the top of the bed, then a thin layer of sand is added on top. No people.
shots.narration: 样品吸附后，加一层砂保护。
overlay: 加保护砂层，加满洗脱剂

shots.section_title: 加保护砂层，加满洗脱剂
shots.scene: 沿壁加满洗脱剂
shots.prompt_en: Eluent is added gently down the wall until the column is full. No people.
shots.narration: 再沿壁加满洗脱剂。

shots.scene: 打开活塞，液体滴下
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock opens and liquid drips steadily from the column tip. No people.
shots.narration: 开活塞，开始洗脱。

shots.scene: 试管架上一排编号试管
shots.prompt_en: A rack of test tubes with number icons placed under the column. No people.
shots.narration: 稍后起，用编号容器依次收集。

shots.scene: 满一管换一管
shots.prompt_en: A filled tube is swapped for the next empty tube under the drip. No people.
shots.narration: 满了就换，新组分快出来时提前换。

shots.scene: 小研盯着柱子液面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the liquid level at the top of the column closely.
shots.narration: 收集时要一直盯着液面。

shots.scene: 液面下降，沿壁补加洗脱剂
shots.prompt_en: As the level drops, eluent is added gently down the wall before it reaches the bed. No people.
shots.narration: 降到硅胶之前，沿壁轻轻补加。

shots.scene: 柱中绿色带分成黄色和蓝色两条
shots.prompt_en: Inside the column, a dark green band splits into a yellow band moving down and a blue band staying higher. No people.
shots.narration: 绿色混合物，渐渐分成黄、蓝两条。

shots.scene: 所有液体流进一个大瓶又混在一起，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of all bands draining into one large flask and mixing again, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接在一个瓶里，就又混回去了。

shots.scene: 前几管无色，后面变黄
shots.prompt_en: A row of tubes: the first few clear, the next ones yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 起初流出的只是溶剂。

shots.scene: 持续加液，直到蓝色也流出
shots.prompt_en: Later tubes turn blue as the blue band reaches the bottom of the column. No people.
shots.narration: 一直加液收集，直到组分全部流出。

shots.scene: 一块板上点了十个馏分
shots.prompt_en: A wide plate with ten spotted lanes; some lanes show a blue spot, others a red spot. No people.
shots.narration: 看不见时，用薄层色谱检测各馏分。

shots.scene: 三个小瓶合并到一个圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three small numbered flasks pour into one round-bottom flask. No people.
shots.narration: 含同一物质的馏分合并。

shots.scene: 旋转蒸发仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple rotary evaporator icon with a spinning flask over a warm bath. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸掉溶剂，得到纯净的产物。

shots.scene: 目标馏分打勾，其他馏分被推到一边
shots.prompt_en: One flask with a green check; the other flasks are pushed aside. No people.
shots.narration: 其余可以处理掉，有时要留多个产物。

shots.scene: 紫外分光光度计和比色管图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a simple spectrophotometer and a color comparison tube set. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以用紫外吸收或比色法鉴定。

shots.scene: 小研举起一管黄色馏分
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a tube of yellow fraction and smiles.
shots.narration: 这次有颜色，用眼睛就能分辨。

shots.scene: 随时间极性逐渐升高的渐变条
shots.prompt_en: A gradient bar shifting from light to dark beside a column, an arrow showing time. No people.
shots.narration: 可以换几种溶剂，或者梯度洗脱。

shots.scene: 三种不同颗粒的填料图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of different column packing materials: white beads, a soft gel and fine porous beads. No people.
shots.narration: 填料也不只硅胶，还有凝胶等。

shots.scene: 大小、电荷、极性三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: big and small balls, plus and minus signs, and a polarity symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 可按大小、电荷、极性来分离。

shots.scene: 带空白屏幕的自动化色谱仪
shots.prompt_en: A generic automated chromatography instrument with a blank screen and tubing. No people.
shots.narration: 大规模分离可以自动化完成。

shots.scene: 蛋白质分子图标与色谱柱
shots.prompt_en: A protein molecule icon next to a small column connected to a generic instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 比如专门分离蛋白质的快速液相色谱。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现棉花、砂、硅胶匀浆图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of cotton, sand and a beaker of slurry.
shots.narration: 关活塞、塞棉花、铺平砂、湿法装柱。

shots.scene: 液面高于硅胶、窄色带两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: liquid above the bed, and a thin sharp sample band. No people.
shots.narration: 柱子不跑干，样品上成窄带。

shots.scene: 编号试管和薄层板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of numbered test tubes and a plate with spots. No people.
shots.narration: 分批收集，薄层检测，合并除溶剂。

shots.scene: 梯度条、凝胶填料、蛋白质图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gradient bar, soft gel beads and a protein molecule. No people.
shots.narration: 梯度洗脱、多种填料，还能自动化。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台旁的色谱柱边挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a lab bench with a column clamped on a ring stand.
shots.narration: 一根柱子分得清，下次再见！
